jobs.title: Saved
jobs.pick: Plays when you save a new task or an edit. No wood this time: a small metal latch closing, or a stamp on paper.

sources.label: latch_click
sources.name: Metal latch on a tin box

jobs.title: Badge earned
jobs.pick: Plays when you earn a badge. Two real things: a pin badge being fastened, and a medal knocking against another medal. The last row is built from the iron hit you already chose, so it belongs to the same family as Done: 1 is two quick hits then a higher one, 2 is one bright hit that rings out.

jobs.title: Buttons and tabs
jobs.pick: You did not choose one for this last time, so buttons and tabs are silent right now. Choose a take if you want a very quiet tap, or choose no sound to keep them silent.

review.name: Done
review.where: Logging a task as done. Two hits, the second one higher.

review.name: Fallback
review.where: Logging the fallback. One softer, duller hit.

review.name: Day finished
review.where: When the last task of the day is logged. A short rising run with a little echo.

review.name: Level up
review.where: A longer rising run with a wider echo. The loudest sound in the app.

review.name: Reminder
review.where: Arrives with a notification. Two calm hits, softened, with a little echo.

review.name: Could not save
review.where: Two quick knocks, the second one lower.

review.name: Switch on
review.where: Very quiet. Slightly higher than switch off.

review.name: Switch off
review.where: Very quiet. Slightly lower than switch on.

review.name: Step ticked
review.where: Ticking one step of a routine.

review.name: To-do ticked
review.where: The pencil check mark. Plays when you tick a to-do on the To-dos tab.

review.name: Moved to tomorrow
review.where: Paper swish, take 4, as you asked.

review.name: Assistant finished
review.where: Two flicks with a little echo. Made, but not used in the app yet.
